environments.platform: Windows production builds (vinext and local Wrangler); Codex in-app browser, same 127.0.0.1:8873 origin. Both builds use the same lockfile and 7,268 local artist asset files.
environments.baseline: GitHub application 2aba484b (v212). The controlled run was built afresh from that application source on Windows.
environments.input: Same anonymous browser projection of the versioned project snapshot; personal notes, scores and watch state are blank. No real owner response is included.
environments.viewport: The iframe is set to 1280 × 820 CSS px. Body width is read from the target document for every successful observation.
environments.cache: The session and browser cache are reused. Group and global API responses are private, no-store and uncompressed in this loopback test. Resource Timing reports nonempty cached resource counts per attempt. First navigation is not a physically cold-cache result.
environments.playback: Measurement stops at visible controls. No third-party playback, login, score writes or owner data were part of these runs.

scenes.home: A fresh document navigation. The first matching local work card of the agreed design is visible, enabled and links to the same work ID. The card can be below the first screen; record its vertical position.
scenes.detail: Scroll the chosen card into view, confirm its clickable surface, click it, then wait for the requested work ID and visible nonempty detail heading. This measures the detail heading, not video playback.
scenes.return: Click the actual detail back control. Wait for the originating group home and its known card.
scenes.works: Activate the group’s own visible works navigation. Wait for the works section and a visible, enabled work action.

measurement.clock: Parent document performance.now() before triggering the navigation or click until the first successful probe; nominal 12 ms polling. Last poll duration provides a timing resolution bound.
measurement.transfer: Read same-origin Resource Timing with resource start >= the action. Fixed 350 ms after readiness for counts and body bytes. Browsers can report zero in this window for late requests. Transfer includes reported header overhead.
measurement.cacheMetric: cachedResourcesAt350Ms counts nonempty same-origin resource responses with reported transferSize 0.
measurement.scope: The 51 home routes have 1 sample per version and are a survey. Timings for IVE, ADYA, and Cherry Bullet use 3 ordered repetitions per version and scenario, with the same proxy handling Prefer for both.
measurement.excluded: Initial scrolling experiment failed to hit the target before smooth scrolling ended. Earlier action runs did not use comparable proxy handling for the detail request or shared test load. Only the corrected runs are used for action comparisons.
measurement.assetLimit: UDTT original local private design material is not mounted. Its actual home ready time is excluded for both versions, while the anonymous HTTP body comparison is present.
